analyzed_vuln.description: In DecodeSingleResponse, the OPENSSL_ALL/WOLFSSL_NGINX/WOLFSSL_HAPROXY code path copies parsed ASN.1 time bytes with XMEMCPY into thisDateParsed.data (and similarly nextDateParsed.data) using length returned by GetDateInfo, but it does not validate that this parsed length fits the destination buffer (WOLFSSL_ASN1_TIME data array). With malformed OCSP SingleResponse date fields, thisDateParsed.length can exceed the fixed buffer, causing an out-of-bounds read/write during memcpy. The crash manifests at the memcpy in DecodeSingleResponse (line ~33761).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The fuzzer calls InitOcspResponse with attacker-controlled input and then OcspResponseDecode. Input must parse far enough as an OCSP BasicResponse/ResponseData/SingleResponse and reach the OPENSSL-compatible date-copy block in DecodeSingleResponse. A crafted ASN.1 thisUpdate (or nextUpdate) date encoding that yields an oversized parsed date length from GetDateInfo triggers the unchecked memcpy length, producing heap-buffer-overflow.

patch_result.patch:
--- a/wolfcrypt/src/asn.c
+++ b/wolfcrypt/src/asn.c
@@ -33758,6 +33758,9 @@
                     (byte*)&single->status->thisDateParsed.type,
                     &single->status->thisDateParsed.length, size) < 0)
         return ASN_PARSE_E;
+    if (single->status->thisDateParsed.length >
+            (word32)sizeof(single->status->thisDateParsed.data))
+        return BUFFER_E;
     XMEMCPY(single->status->thisDateParsed.data,
             single->status->thisDateAsn + localIdx - single->status->thisDateParsed.length,
             single->status->thisDateParsed.length);
@@ -33790,6 +33793,9 @@
                         (byte*)&single->status->nextDateParsed.type,
                         &single->status->nextDateParsed.length, size) < 0)
             return ASN_PARSE_E;
+        if (single->status->nextDateParsed.length >
+                (word32)sizeof(single->status->nextDateParsed.data))
+            return BUFFER_E;
         XMEMCPY(single->status->nextDateParsed.data,
                 single->status->nextDateAsn + localIdx - single->status->nextDateParsed.length,
                 single->status->nextDateParsed.length);
